summary: Our Bond, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to register the resale of up to 34,073,681 shares by existing stockholders in connection with its direct listing on Nasdaq. The supplement discloses amendments to warrants held by Ascent Partners Fund LLC, adjusting exercise prices on 9,000,000 warrants to between $1.25 and $4.50 per share and cancelling 16,291,902 warrants. Additionally, the conversion price of Series D Preferred Stock was adjusted to $2.0265, and leak-out provisions were added to both Series C and D preferred. This is a routine secondary offering disclosure with warrant and preferred stock modifications, not a special situation.
